definitions.explanation: a container for holding writing instruments such as pencils, pens, and erasers

examples.japanese: {筆箱|ふでばこ}に{鉛筆|えんぴつ}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To put a pencil in the pencil case.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{筆箱|ふでばこ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new pencil case.

examples.japanese: {筆箱|ふでばこ}を{忘|わす}れてきた。

notes:
COMPOSITION:
{筆|ふで} (writing brush/pen) + {箱|はこ} (box)

TYPES:
- {缶|かん}{筆箱|ふでばこ} (metal pencil case - common with children)
- {布製|ぬのせい}{筆箱|ふでばこ} (fabric pencil case)
- ポーチ{型|がた} (pouch-style)

ALTERNATIVE TERM:
ペンケース (pen case) is also commonly used, especially by older students and adults.

SCHOOL SUPPLY:
Essential item for Japanese students. Elementary school students often use hard plastic or metal cases, while older students prefer soft pouches.

TYPICAL CONTENTS:
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ} (pencil)
- {消|け}しゴム (eraser)
- {定規|じょうぎ} (ruler)
- シャープペンシル (mechanical pencil)
- ボールペン (ballpoint pen)

RELATED:
- {文房具|ぶんぼうぐ} (stationery)
- ペンケース (pen case)
- {道具箱|どうぐばこ} (tool box)
